methodology: Four fresh-browser captures per project in control/clone/clone/control order; same native executable and project, normal motion, no throttling, no simultaneous build/test/inference/sampler. Two desktop repetitions do not establish field percentiles or universal improvement. Incomplete native rings are excluded from native attribution.
